metadata.title: Barakah Bazaar · Halal, wholesome, home-delivered
metadata.description: Bangladesh's halal-first marketplace: dates and dry fruits, fresh doi and rosmalai, groceries and care products, delivered to your door.

result.title: Payment result

paid.heading: Payment received
paid.body: Thank you. We have your bKash payment and are getting the order ready.

pending.heading: Confirming your payment
pending.body: bKash has not told us the result yet. It usually settles within a few minutes, and your order page will show it. Please do not pay twice.

failed.heading: The payment did not go through
failed.body: If bKash took any money for this attempt, it goes back to your account automatically. You can try bKash again or pay in cash on delivery.

cancelled.heading: You cancelled the payment
cancelled.body: Your order is still waiting. You can try bKash again or pay in cash on delivery.

result.noOrder: We could not tell which order this payment was for. Your orders page shows where each one stands.
